content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The footprint definition is where what an operation keeps meets the op-log read; the gate forces the definition to answer to the read without re-deciding it. The prerequisite is an artifact read as prose here, so its cell is the matrix default — the gate plus a flag to extend the matrix.
